name: recon_qa
description: Quality assurance for reconciliation workbooks and outputs. Validates formula accuracy, cross-sheet consistency, balance tie-outs, category completeness, and common spreadsheet errors. Companion skill to recon_analysis — run after export to verify output integrity. Triggers: QA recon, audit recon workbook, check recon output, validate reconciliation, sanity check recon, review recon export, reconciliation quality check, verify recon results.
